面条儿.pinyin: jīntiān zhōngwǔ wǒmen chī miàntiáoér ba

面条儿.en: This bowl of noodles is so delicious.

面条儿.zh: 妈妈做的面条儿比外面的好吃。
面条儿.en: The noodles mom makes are tastier than the ones outside.
面条儿.pinyin: māmā zuò de miàntiáoér bǐ wàimiàn de hǎochī

面条儿.zh: 如果饿的话，你可以先煮点面条儿吃。
面条儿.en: If you're hungry, you can cook some noodles first.
面条儿.pinyin: rúguǒ è dehuà nǐ kěyǐ xiān zhǔ diǎn miàntiáoér chī

一下儿.en: Can you help me a bit?
一下儿.pinyin: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yīxià ér ma

一下儿.zh: 让我想一下儿再回答你。
一下儿.en: Let me think a moment before answering you.
一下儿.pinyin: ràng wǒ xiǎng yīxià ér zài huídá nǐ

一下儿.zh: 你用一下儿这个电脑试试。
一下儿.en: Try using this computer for a bit.
一下儿.pinyin: nǐ yòng yīxià ér zhège diànnǎo shìshì

一下儿.zh: 因为太吵了，所以我休息了一下儿。
一下儿.en: Because it was too noisy, I rested for a bit.
一下儿.pinyin: yīnwèi tàichǎo le suǒyǐ wǒ xiūxī le yīxià ér

有一些.en: I have some more questions to ask.
有一些.pinyin: wǒ háiyǒu yīxiē wèntí yào wèn

有一些.en: There are some books and pens on the table.

有一些.zh: 虽然有一些难，但是很有意思。
有一些.en: Although it's a bit difficult, it's very interesting.
有一些.pinyin: suīrán yǒu yīxiē nán dànshì hěn yǒuyìsi

有一些.zh: 你包里还有有一些钱吗？
有一些.en: Do you still have some money in your bag?
有一些.pinyin: nǐ bāolǐ háiyǒu yǒu yīxiē qián ma
